correctness.rationale: For \(k=2\) and \(b=1\), the source equations reduce reversibly to \(x_1=\widetilde a\), \(x_2x_3=\widetilde a^2\), and \((m-1)(m^2+(1-a)m+1)=0\) with \(m=x_2/\widetilde a>0\). The quadratic discriminant is \((a-3)(a+1)\), giving exactly one positive solution for \(0<a\le3\) and exactly three for \(a>3\). The non-diagonal pair has \(t=m^{-1}\), which directly falsifies the source implication. All steps are algebraic and quantified over the full stated domain.
